svg.title: Nixie IN-8-2 Stacked Case + Steampunk Option 1: Victorian Horology & Brass Flanges
svg.desc: Nixie IN-8-2 Low-Profile Stacked Rounded-Corner Case (3.0 mm Multiplex / MDF / Acryl) — ZERO BENDING REQUIRED! - Outer Dimensions: 170.0 x 90.0 mm, R_out = 15.0 mm rounded corners - Total Height: 21.0 mm (with 5 rings) or 24.0 mm (with 6 rings) - Flush Drop-In Top Plate ("Los ingezette bovenplaat"): 164.0 x 84.0 mm, R = 12.0 mm - 4x IN-8-2 Tube Holes (Ø 20.0 mm) & 8x TAF1317A M2 Mounting Holes (Ø 2.1 mm) - 5x Hidden Ø 3.1 mm Alignment Dowel Holes in Layers 1..5 (for 3 mm wooden skewers/dowels — invisible from top & outside!)
